metadata.database: A Deeper China | Shanghai point decision layer

SH001.guest_value: Give a first-time visitor one readable river-scale frame.
SH001.stop_after: The guest can see the Bund as an institutional waterfront, not only a photo wall.

SH002.guest_value: Make the historic/contemporary contrast physical rather than purely narrated.
SH002.choose_rule: Use only when the guest still has energy after the Bund-side reading.
SH002.stop_after: The two-bank relationship is clear; do not add a tower for height.

SH003.guest_value: Turn the crossing into part of the architectural reading, not another attraction.
SH003.choose_rule: Select the mode only after date, weather and boarding conditions are checked.
SH003.stop_after: The crossing has served the comparison; no scenic cruise is added by default.

SH004.guest_value: Begin with street scale, trees and the relationship between public façade and lived neighbourhood.
SH004.choose_rule: Use as the start of one continuous loop, not as a standalone selfie stop.
SH004.stop_after: The street pattern is legible and privacy boundaries remain intact.

SH005.guest_value: Give the architecture-led visitor one precise form-reading moment.
SH005.choose_rule: Keep it brief and exterior; never make a queue or private interior part of the promise.
SH005.stop_after: The building’s massing and setting have been understood.

SH006.guest_value: Provide a quieter public-space observation and a seated recovery option.
SH006.choose_rule: Use when the guest values slow rhythm or needs a low-transfer break.
SH006.stop_after: The guest has observed public use without staging or photographing strangers intrusively.

SH007.guest_value: Convert a famous neighbourhood into a continuous, slower street reading.
SH007.choose_rule: Use only after an actual loop is checked for construction, shade and recovery points.
SH007.stop_after: The loop remains comfortable and the question has been answered; do not complete it for distance alone.

SH008.guest_value: Pair designed garden form with an explanation of old-city commerce and ritual geography.
SH008.choose_rule: Use when history or garden form matters; do not let nearby retail define the visit.
SH008.stop_after: The garden/old-city relationship is clear and crowd load begins to dominate.

SH009.guest_value: Explain ritual economy and current commerce without claiming a staged local experience.
SH009.choose_rule: Add only for explicit religion, history or food-geography intent.
SH009.stop_after: The contextual question is answered; omit retail wandering when sensory load rises.

SH010.guest_value: Offer a broad material-culture frame for a first visit.
SH010.choose_rule: Choose only if its date-specific opening and reservation status fit the route.
SH010.stop_after: One China question has a usable answer; leave before gallery fatigue.

SH011.guest_value: Offer a museum choice that fits an east-bank day.
SH011.choose_rule: Use instead of People’s Square when geography or programme makes it materially better.
SH011.stop_after: The selected question is answered; do not visit both branches by default.

SH012.guest_value: Provide a contemporary-art lens only when the live exhibition matches the guest.
SH012.choose_rule: Never substitute it for history merely because it is nearby or visually impressive.
SH012.stop_after: The current programme has answered the guest’s art/design question.

SH013.guest_value: Offer a modern-China visual-culture lens when the exhibition and radius fit.
SH013.choose_rule: Use by programme and guest question, not by size or free admission.
SH013.stop_after: The selected exhibition has provided the intended visual frame.

SH014.guest_value: Show how a working industrial edge becomes public space.
SH014.choose_rule: Use only for guests willing to trade postcard efficiency for urban-process reading.
SH014.stop_after: Industrial traces, path continuity and current public use are all visible.

SH015.guest_value: Translate work, making and skills into a family- or design-relevant indoor layer.
SH015.choose_rule: Add only when programme, language and transfer fit.
SH015.stop_after: One skills or labour idea is clear; do not add a second museum to compensate.

SH016.guest_value: Potentially connect industrial reuse with active contemporary galleries.
SH016.choose_rule: Never publish as a guaranteed art circuit until active venues are field-confirmed.
SH016.stop_after: The selected gallery or reuse question is answered; do not browse empty units.

SH017.guest_value: Potentially combine contemporary art and riverfront change for a creative visitor.
SH017.choose_rule: Select by current programme and distance tolerance, not by reputation alone.
SH017.stop_after: The programme and riverfront question are both legible; cut the far end if not.

SH018.guest_value: Give a first-time visitor a civic-scale orientation without adding a retail circuit.
SH018.choose_rule: Use as a short contextual stop with the museum, not as an extra attraction.
SH018.stop_after: The central-city frame is understood and attention is still fresh.

SH019.guest_value: Offer a calmer version of a famous view by changing time rather than adding places.
SH019.choose_rule: Use as a morning variant, not in addition to a full evening skyline plan.
SH019.stop_after: The quiet public-space quality is achieved; return before heat or fatigue rises.

SH020.guest_value: Potentially connect public-space etiquette, embodied practice and the guest’s Shanghai resource.
SH020.choose_rule: Mention only as a research candidate when English teaching and a suitable date are explicit needs.
SH020.stop_after: Do not treat a teacher lead as an experience until language, credentials, venue, capacity, price, filming consent, booking and safety gates are all passed.

SH021.guest_value: Help the guest decide whether Hangzhou adds landscape and tea culture rather than another rushed city day.
SH021.choose_rule: Use only when there is at least one extra full day, a clear Jiangnan interest and acceptance of a slower pace.
SH021.stop_after: The guest can name the different question Hangzhou adds and accept the transfer/overnight cost.

SH022.guest_value: Help the guest decide whether Suzhou adds gardens, canals and heritage rather than another checklist day.
SH022.choose_rule: Use only when garden/canal intent is explicit and the transfer does not damage the main Shanghai plan.
SH022.stop_after: The guest can name the new question Suzhou answers and accept the pacing trade-off.

SH023.guest_value: Offer a less postcard-driven waterway lens on industry, ecology and public space.
SH023.choose_rule: Use only after continuity, construction and rest points are field-checked.
SH023.stop_after: One industrial trace and one current public use are legible; stop at the first continuity break.

SH024.guest_value: Show the port-facing edge that the central Bund cannot explain.
SH024.choose_rule: Use for repeat visitors or explicit port/history interest, not as a second skyline stop by default.
SH024.stop_after: The guest can state what the North Bund adds to the central Bund story.

SH025.guest_value: Provide a careful, focused entry into refugee and diaspora history.
SH025.choose_rule: Use when the guest explicitly wants this history; do not turn trauma into a neighbourhood spectacle.
SH025.stop_after: The guest has a grounded historical frame and enough emotional space to process it.

SH026.guest_value: Show how ritual time and temple-city relationships operate beyond generic sightseeing.
SH026.choose_rule: Use for explicit religion/history interest and explain etiquette before entry or photography.
SH026.stop_after: One relationship between ritual practice and urban life is understood.

SH027.guest_value: Offer a second urban-religion lens only when comparison is the guest’s actual question.
SH027.choose_rule: Do not combine with Longhua by default; choose one temple unless the comparison earns the transfer.
SH027.stop_after: The comparison question is answered without treating worshippers as content.

SH028.guest_value: Read temple, metro, retail and high-density movement in one compact district.
SH028.choose_rule: Use when the guest wants urban contrast, not a shopping itinerary.
SH028.stop_after: The sacred-commercial coexistence is clear and crowd load has not taken over.

SH029.guest_value: Give cinema and media visitors a programme-led visual-culture frame.
SH029.choose_rule: Select only when the current programme and language support match the guest.
SH029.stop_after: One film/media idea has been understood; do not add another visual-culture venue automatically.

SH030.guest_value: Potentially answer a design and political-visual-culture question through posters and mass imagery.
SH030.choose_rule: Use only after access, location and ticketing are verified; never as a generic hidden gem claim.
SH030.stop_after: The selected visual system answers the guest’s question; do not add a second museum to compensate.

SH031.guest_value: Give an architecture visitor one clear case of preservation becoming public use.
SH031.choose_rule: Use as a short case study, not as a reason to tour unrelated façades.
SH031.stop_after: The guest can identify what was preserved, changed and made public.

SH032.guest_value: Connect a street-scale walk with modern Chinese literary and civic history.
SH032.choose_rule: Use only when a coherent loop and current venues are field-checked.
SH032.stop_after: One street, author or debate has become legible; do not keep walking for plaque collection.

SH033.guest_value: Use breakfast timing, ordering and table rhythm to read food as social geography.
SH033.choose_rule: No specific shop, price or participatory promise before venue, dietary and language checks.
SH033.stop_after: The guest understands one timing or ordering pattern and has eaten safely.

SH034.guest_value: Give a long-haul arrival one meaningful, low-decision Shanghai moment.
SH034.choose_rule: Build only after hotel area, arrival time, payment and return route are known.
SH034.stop_after: The guest is oriented, fed, connected and safely back without performing tourism.

SH035.guest_value: Connect contemporary art with industrial reuse for a creative worker or design visitor.
SH035.choose_rule: Choose by current programme, not by institution name alone.
SH035.stop_after: One contemporary practice or institutional choice is clear; avoid a second art district by default.

SH036.guest_value: Give families an age-fit indoor learning layer with recovery time built in.
SH036.choose_rule: Select by age, queue tolerance, toilets and current programme, not adult interest alone.
SH036.stop_after: Child and adult can each name one thing they noticed before attention collapses.

SH037.guest_value: Create depth through repeated public observation without extracting private life.
SH037.choose_rule: Use one public route or park edge; never direct guests into residential compounds or private routines.
SH037.stop_after: A public pattern has been observed across visits without intrusive recording or staged contact.

SH038.guest_value: Help photographers make strong public compositions without assuming consent from strangers.
SH038.choose_rule: Use explicit stop rules for faces, children, worship, private thresholds and restricted venues.
SH038.stop_after: One visual question is answered without relying on intrusive capture.

SH039.guest_value: Pass a Suzhou decision to a separate approved database instead of improvising a generic itinerary.
SH039.choose_rule: Use only after time, pacing and garden/canal intent are explicit.
SH039.stop_after: The guest has made a transfer decision; do not pretend this handoff is a full Suzhou roadbook.

SH040.guest_value: Pass a Hangzhou decision to a separate approved database instead of improvising a generic itinerary.
SH040.choose_rule: Use only after landscape/tea intent and overnight capacity are explicit.
SH040.stop_after: The guest has made a transfer decision; do not present the handoff as a full Hangzhou roadbook.
